title: 소비자단체소송규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00008:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 8 (Examination of Applications for Permission to Institute Lawsuits)
(1) Where an application for permission to institute a lawsuit contains defects in the matters required to be stated therein or the accompanying documents, the presiding judge shall order correction of the defects within a reasonable period specified by the judge.
(2) Where the plaintiff fails to correct the defects notwithstanding the order of the presiding judge under paragraph (1), the court shall deny permission for the organization lawsuit by ruling.
